resources.string: Use the camera or choose an image. Scanning works offline without Google Play services.
Point the camera at a configuration QR code
No QR code found. Try a clear, uncropped image.
Local routing rules, independent of language and VPN server location.
Local sites connect directly without the VPN server. Other traffic uses VPN.
Suggested from your phone settings. You can change both choices.
Paste a server or subscription link, scan a QR code, or choose a backup. You can add a server later.
All apps follow your routing rules. To choose apps or exclusions, open the list below. Apply your choice to return here, or use Back to setup.
Android will ask for VPN permission when you connect. You can refuse and connect later. Notifications show connection status.
The link could not be imported. Check the format or add it later in Servers.
Server link will be imported after confirmation.
Use at least 8 characters. To restore an encrypted file, enter its password here before importing. Keep it safe: it cannot be recovered.
Loyalsoldier / GitHub. Downloads are checked against SHA-256 and validated by Xray. Applied on the next connection.
Update failed. The working databases are still available. Try again through a connected VPN.

Choose a saved profile to permit automatic application when connecting or switching to this network type. The reviewed settings are saved with this binding. Changes briefly restart VPN and are recorded in the log. Remove a binding to stop automation.
Save a profile in the connection mode menu first.

Inspects HTTPS domain rules from the active configuration, without sending a request. IP routing, browser DNS and app exclusions can change the final route. Open the site to see observed connections below.
No domain-specific rule found. Check live connections for the final route.
Connect VPN and enter a valid domain, then retry.

Direct exceptions bypass the VPN server. App exceptions bypass the whole tunnel; Android Kill Switch may block their internet access. Expiry is checked while VPN runs; old settings return with a brief reconnection. Permanent rules remain saved.
Could not add exception. Check the domain or installed package and keep at least one app in selective VPN mode.
Shows the VPN connection state and speed
Backup selected. It will be merged after confirmation.
Download subscriptions and geodata through active VPN
Requires an already working VPN server. If VPN is off, these downloads fail rather than switching back to the physical network. Turn this option off when adding your first subscription.

Offline recovery: keep an encrypted backup or configuration QR code on another device. Import it through Servers or Backup and restore. To use a mirror, edit the source URL yourself; the app does not silently replace providers. A TLS error calls for checking the phone date or source certificate.
The passwords must match and contain at least 8 characters.
Devices must enter the login and password shown below.
Authentication is off. Leave the username and password empty on the connecting device.
Explore the code, follow releases or suggest an improvement on GitHub.
Protect the exported file with a password.
Choose a route and duration for a website. Permanent rules include subdomains; temporary rules apply only to the exact domain. App routing is on the Apps screen.
Checks a DNS answer on your current network. VPN routing rules apply while connected.
